description: ACCDB: on a true client static batch-optimistic (3,3,4) Recordset of W, tests every operation while an unposted field Put (EditMode=1) or unposted AddNew (EditMode=2) is open: Find, Filter, Sort, Clone, Requery, Resync, MoveNext, MoveFirst, AddNew, Delete, CancelUpdate, CancelBatch, UpdateBatch, Close. Captures EditMode, Status, RecordCount, Errors, and keeps all pages before/after.
